title.en: Creating the Position of Assistant Secretary for Personnel Management and Development in Every Executive Department

text.en:
There shall be created in each of the executive departments the position of Assistant Secretary
for Personnel Management and Development which shall advice the Secretary of all matters pertaining to
personnel planning, management and development for the Department and the bureaus and agencies under it,
and shall implement the programs of the Government or the Department along these lines in order to improve
the quality of the public service, and he shall likewise be the principal liaison official of the Department with
the Civil Service Commission, the central personnel agency of the government, and the office responsible for
establishing a career system in the civil service, for professionalizing the service, for initiating, establishing
and integrating the career and employee development programs of the Government.

In those departments where there are two or more Undersecretaries, one of whom is an
Undersecretary for Administration, the Secretary may assign these personnel planning management and
development duties to said Undersecretary or in his discretion appoint an Assistant Secretary as provided in
this Decree.

Except those which are attached or otherwise administered or supervised by a department,
government-owned or controlled corporations may create a similar position with the same duties as prescribed
under this Decree, if such is considered necessary by them.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
